correctness.rationale: The exact machine has states (r,Y) with r mod P_a(m), Y in X(Z/m)[X]/(X^{b+1}). The least binomial period P_a(m) is established prime power by prime power using Vandermonde, Lucas, and v_p(binomial(T,j)). The first a counters are injective in r. At any phase, positive return words realize F_0 and F_1, whose commutator-like product yields translation by X; conjugation yields X(1+X)^j, a unitriangular module basis, so all P_a(m)m^b states are reached. The greatest differing prefix-counter coordinate and its completing pattern suffix distinguish every pair. Modular checker: 201 triples, 93596 reachable states, 4236 period checks and 49056 direct embedding comparisons. Separate parity checker: 54 pairs, 13196 reachable states and 24042 literal words. Computations check finite cases only; the quantified proof is independent of enumeration.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Substituting b=1 into m^b P_a(m) gives exactly the known 0^a1 count. Substituting a=b=2 gives m^3 gcd(m,2), exactly the known 0011 count. These implications run from the new theorem to the two prior cases, not conversely: neither prior statement controls the b independent terminal-one counter coordinates for arbitrary b. The new F0/F1 affine-module basis proves that missing reachability and distinguishability uniformly. General algorithmic XNFA theorems concern algorithmic upper bounds and cannot imply this exact Myhill-Nerode/Moore index without a separate orbit calculation.

originality.rationale: The new all-parameter minimal Moore-state formula for 0^a1^b, b arbitrary, is not entailed by the isolated b=1 modular-DFA result or the 0011 modular-Moore result, although both are precisely recovered as special cases. Source full texts establish those two exact boundaries. Generalized Parikh matrices give counting representations without minimal state orbits; the 2026 XNFA work gives algorithmic complexity results without this exact family. Search and comparison did not reveal a full b-general theorem. Two plausible primary works remain incompletely accessible and unindexed priority is possible; originality is against inspected evidence, not a proof of global uniqueness.

value.rationale: Minimal deterministic memory for modular counts is a natural parameter of weighted-automaton determinization and sequence statistics. The two-run family has asymmetric information structure: the first run contributes exactly the sharp binomial period P_a(m), while every subsequent 1 in the target contributes an independently reachable residue coordinate, a full free module. This resolves all run lengths and all composite and prime moduli in one structural theorem, gives exact state-cost staircases, and explains known disjoint cases. The result is not an arbitrary finite calculation, a known-table recomputation, or a textbook one-line consequence of the prior special cases.
